title: Provenance
description: Origin and licensing metadata for a creative asset or text. Required on every printing's art; defaultable at game level. Built in from day one (locked decision D8).

source.description: How this asset was created. 'unknown' is valid only for imported legacy content and should be resolved before publishing.

creator.description: Name of the human creator or commissioning party.

license.description: License of this specific asset if it differs from the game license (SPDX/CC code).

ai_tool.description: If source is ai/mixed: the generator used.
